description: VYBE Music v5.0.1 - Listen Together Instant Host Skip Sync, In-Track Seek Guard, Immediate Track Broadcast, and 8 New Official App Icons.

announcement.title: Welcome To VYBE Music v5.0.1
announcement.message: Enjoy real-time Listen Together synchronized skipping & seeking, 8 new official app icons, and enhanced stability!

changelog.title: 8 New Official App Icons & System Enhancements
items: 8 Official App Icons: Added 8 built-in icons (Lofi Sunset Monkey, Meow Beats Cat, Cloud Melody Pup, Holo Vinyl Disc, Midnight Anime Boy, Cosmic Pixel Saturn, Retro Glitch Cat, Halftone Cyber Cat) visible to all users
Admin Controls Privacy: Restricted Admin Icon Controls upload panel strictly to verified administrators
Leadership & Contributors: Added Founder and Co-Founder direct profile links and clean live contributor synchronization
Silent Admin Portal Access: Removed countdown toast when opening the admin portal

changelog.title: TERON TECH (IT Sector) Rebranding
items: Official Startup Migration: Fully transitioned organization branding and repository to TERON TECH (IT Sector)
Updated License & Docs: GPL v3.0 copyright and comprehensive metadata updated to reflect TERON TECH

changelog.title: App Icon Customization & Crash Fix
items: Navigation Crash Resolved: Fixed destination route settings/app_icon missing error
Custom Storage Upload: Admin and users can select custom app icons from phone gallery/storage with smooth scrolling and responsive UI

changelog.title: Playlist & Playback Fixes
items: Fixed Disappearing Playlists: Local & imported playlists are now permanently bookmarked and protected from being wiped or hidden on library refresh or account sync
Complete Pagination: YouTube playlists import all tracks across pages with zero missing songs and full dynamic mix/radio support

changelog.title: Real Phone Stream Playback
items: Fixed Mobile Network 403 Forbidden: Corrected User-Agent matching and added range probe fallback so streams play reliably on real phones and cellular networks (Jio, Airtel, etc.)
Fallback Stream Resolution: Seamless fallback to high-compatibility stream formats if direct probe is restricted

changelog.title: Listen Together Synchronized Playback
items: Instant Host Skip Sync: When the host skips a song (Next or Previous), all guests immediately transition to the exact new song instead of replaying the old song
In-Track Seek Guard: Fixed false SEEK(0ms) events during song transitions that caused previous tracks to restart from the beginning on guests
Immediate Track Broadcast: Bypassed syncing lock during track transitions so the host always broadcasts the new song's YouTube metadata to everyone in the room
Instant Pause on Guest Phones: When the host pauses, stops, or changes songs, guest devices immediately pause instead of continuing to play
Track End Handling: End-of-track and player clearing are synchronized across all connected listeners

changelog.title: Battery Usage Optimization
items: Background Widget Optimization: Disabled 1-second background refresh loop when no home screen widgets are active
Optimized WiFi & Wake Locks: Reduced network locks and minimized UI polling frequency during playback to drastically reduce battery drain

changelog.title: Listening Stats in Library
items: Replaced Recap: Display total listening hours and days since the app was installed right in your library
Quick Access to Insights: Tap the listening stats button to jump straight into detailed stats and history
